technical_duplicates.note: Final node uses phoneNumber ?? phoneNumberFormatted fallback; both exist in prep. Upstream Set nodes should standardize to single field.

Callers must choose exactly one: text (messageBody) vs interactive (interactivePayload) vs template (templateParams). No validation in WF-50 entry; form factory (WF-22) is responsible.

type_contradictions.note: Field is required for WA send but existing pseudo does not document type. Runtime executions always string or null.

dead_pass.note: WF-30 Payment branch passes message without messageType; final node reads messageType from prep, but prep.messageType is not guaranteed upstream. Likely set in shared Prepare node, not enforced.

caller_missing_required.missing_in: 20 of 24 sites pass phoneNumber indirectly (Set node upstream_nodes are not tracked in workflowInputs_value; they're in separate code field). Only 4 sites pass phoneNumber directly to WF-50 executeWorkflow.params.
caller_missing_required.note: BUG: Most callers assume prior Set node will pass phoneNumber, but Set node code is opaque to this analysis. Risk: if Set node omits phoneNumber, WF-50 entry fails. Recommend: make phoneNumber explicit in all 24 callsites.

subagent_notes: WF-50 has no documented input/output contract (pseudo is empty). Runtime contract is fragmented: 4 different field-name aliases for message content, 3 variants for phone-number sources. Found 1 MEDIUM severity gap (phoneNumber assumed but not passed explicitly in 20/24 sites). Recommend: (1) audit upstream Set nodes to verify phoneNumber always exists before WF-50 call, (2) establish single canonical field names for {message, phoneNumber, interactivePayload, messageType}, (3) update pseudo with this revised contract, (4) add input validation at WF-50 trigger (error handler if phoneNumber missing).
